title: Project X Promotional Song Tester Agreement
html:
Project X Promotional Song Tester Agreement

Private sharing permission for approved free song samples

This optional agreement lets an enrolled tester receive Project X songs at no charge while tester status is active and share each approved finished MP3 privately with friends and family. It is separate from the Volunteer Improvement Agreement and does not authorize public promotion or use of voice data for training or advertising.

Tester name________________________________________
Project X account email________________________________________
Tester status begins__________________
StatusActive until revoked by the tester or SDP

1. Promotional songs

There is no preset limit on the number of promotional songs a tester may request while tester status is active. Each promotional song has a $0 price, uses no song credits, starts no subscription, and creates no payment obligation. Requests remain subject to the normal account, production, safety, and voice-profile checks.

Each request follows the normal Project X production and review process. The tester can listen to the watermarked preview and choose whether to approve the finished version. After approval, SDP will prepare the clean MP3 and send it to the verified email on the tester’s account. A request may be paused or declined if required production, account, safety, or voice-profile checks are not met. Promotional status does not change voice-model certification or bypass production controls.

2. Private sharing permission

After receiving the clean MP3, the tester may send it directly to friends and family for their personal listening. This permission is limited to private, non-commercial sharing. The tester must not sell or license the sample, post it publicly, submit it to a public music or social platform, use it in advertising, or represent it as an official public endorsement of SDP or Project X.

If the final product includes promotional content attached to it, the tester must include that content when forwarding the product as a gift.

Public demonstrations, social-media posts, paid promotion, and use by SDP in advertising are not included. They require separate written permission from the relevant people and SDP before publication.

3. Separate from volunteer participation

Joining this promotional program is optional and does not enroll the tester in the Volunteer Improvement Program. Volunteer consent alone does not provide promotional samples or permission to distribute them. Promotional consent alone does not authorize SDP to use training recordings, voice profiles, private test outputs, or other volunteer materials for advertising, public demonstrations, model training, or product improvement. Any such use remains governed by a separate, explicit agreement.

Declining or leaving this promotional program does not affect the tester’s ability to use the regular paid service. The program does not grant access to another person’s account, voice profile, or production data.

4. Revoking tester status

Tester status has no fixed end date and remains active until revoked. The tester may withdraw at any time by contacting SDP. SDP may revoke tester status at any time, with or without cause, by giving notice to the tester. Revocation stops new promotional requests immediately. SDP may cancel pending promotional requests that have not yet been delivered. Songs already completed and delivered remain available to the tester, and recipients are not required to erase copies already shared privately. Any separate volunteer-data permissions and withdrawal rights continue to be handled under the Volunteer Improvement Agreement.

5. Online acceptance

Before acceptance is offered, the complete agreement must be presented to the tester in the online enrollment flow. The tester must be signed in to the Project X account listed above and enter their name. The agreement checkbox must be unchecked by default. Tester status begins only after the tester selects the checkbox and submits the form. SDP records the verified account email, member or customer identifier, typed name, acceptance date and time, and the version of these terms. This electronic record replaces a handwritten signature.
